newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes twice raided suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Wednesday night after Katyusha rockets hit northern Israel, security sources said.

The planes fired five rockets into Iqlim al-Toufah ridge, controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas. Hours earlier, one Israeli soldier was killed and four wounded in a clash with Hizbollah guerrillas in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air strikes, the sources said.

Before the raids, pro-Israeli militia sources said several Katyusha rockets fired from south Lebanon slammed into the western Galilee and 12 rockets hit the Israeli-held zone in an area near the Lebanon-Israel border.

No group immediately claimed responsibility for firing the rockets but the attack came hours after a clash with Hizbollah fighters in the Shoumariyeh area in the south Lebanon zone in which one Israeli soldier was killed and four wounded.

Hizbollah (Party of God) is leading a guerrilla war against Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong South Lebanon Army militia holding the 15-km (nine-miles) south Lebanon zone intended to protect northern Israel from cross-frontier raids.
